content:
name: "Copilot Setup Steps"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"

jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"
    timeout-minutes: 59
    permissions:
      contents: "read"
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout code"
        uses: "actions/checkout@v5"
      - name: "Set up Bun"
        uses: "oven-sh/setup-bun@v2"
        with:
          bun-version: "1.2.20"
      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: "bun install --frozen-lockfile"
